narrative: Gross loans reached £5.18Bn in September, up 11% this year from £4.66Bn, on £1.72Bn of originations and £1.20Bn of redemptions. Bridging is growing fastest (£640M) but needs £50–60M of completions a month to stand still because of its 12–18 month life. Development finance is £45M above plan as unit sales slow in the South East. The asset finance and HLF run-off books (£150M) amortise about £14M a month.
